verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs describe connecting custom MCP servers so it can use them as live context while building (internal CRMs, private APIs, knowledge bases). Workspace MCP registries let members connect servers as chat connectors in a couple of clicks, and the desktop app adds local MCP server support, so plugging in MCP servers is a documented first-party capability. Missing for 10: detail on actively invoking MCP tools beyond reading them as context, local servers outside the desktop app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
